description: Scaffold the molecules folder/barrel + i18n keys, then build the 5 self-contained selection/input molecules that have no cross-molecule or Figma-asset dependency: Selectable Card, Pagination, Button Group, Dropdown Labeled, Password Toggle. Independent of FEAT-002 and FEAT-003 except that it creates the shared src/components/molecules/index.ts barrel and the `molecules` i18n namespace that all later features extend. Compose from existing atoms/icons; do not duplicate atom styling.
steps: Create src/components/molecules/index.ts as the barrel (model on src/components/ui/index.ts). Add named re-exports as each component below lands; it must have at least one export before FEAT completes so lint does not flag an empty module.

Add a `molecules` namespace to BOTH messages/en.json and messages/ar.json, kept in sync, with keys: previous, next, page (e.g. 'Page {page}' / 'صفحة {page}'), showPassword, hidePassword. (searchPlaceholder, search, progress, expand, collapse are added in FEAT-002; add only what this FEAT uses, but leave the namespace ready.)

Selectable Card: src/components/molecules/selectable-card.tsx ('use client'). cva `selectableCardVariants` with a selected model mirroring ui/tags.tsx — Default (text-muted-foreground, bg-muted, border-muted-foreground), Hover (hover:border-primary hover:bg-primary-light hover:text-primary), Pressed/selected (text-primary, bg-card, border-primary), Disabled. rounded-sm, px-4 py-2, border, gap-2. Leading icon slot prop. Controllable `selected` + `value`; reflect to aria-checked + data-state; `role` prop defaulting to 'radio' (also 'checkbox'); keyboard Enter/Space toggles; focus-visible ring token. Heading text-sm font-medium, subheading text-xs. forwardRef<HTMLButtonElement>. Re-export from barrel.

Pagination: src/components/molecules/pagination.tsx ('use client'). Page item 40x40 (size-10), rounded-full, text-xs font-medium; Default text-primary bg-card, Selected bg-primary text-primary-foreground border border-primary-hover. Prev/Next controls reuse the Button atom (appearance='ghost'); arrows from @/components/icons LeftArrowIcon/RightArrowIcon chosen by logical position so Previous is inline-start and Next inline-end (RTL-aware; never hardcode left/right). Props page, pageCount, onPageChange. Render <nav aria-label> with page <button>s; mark current with aria-current='page'. i18n previous/next/page. Re-export from barrel.

Button Group: src/components/molecules/button-group.tsx ('use client'). Segmented control reusing Button atom tokens. cva wrapper that joins buttons: logical radius only on the ends ([&>*:first-child]:rounded-s-md [&>*:last-child]:rounded-e-md, rounded-none between) and collapse the shared border. Controlled `value` + `onValueChange`; active item renders pressed (data-state=on → primary pressed bg via Button active classes). role='group'; items are <button aria-pressed>. Re-export from barrel.

Dropdown Labeled: src/components/molecules/dropdown-labeled.tsx. Compose the Label atom + Select atom (SelectTrigger/SelectContent/SelectValue + children items) in a flex flex-col gap-2 (gap 8) wrapper. Props: label, id (wire Label htmlFor to the trigger id), pass-through Select props (value, onValueChange, size, children). No new styling. Re-export from barrel.

Password Toggle: src/components/molecules/password-toggle.tsx ('use client'). A Button (appearance='ghost', size='icon') showing Eye/EyeOff imported from 'lucide-react' (NOT the icon barrel — it does not export them). Controlled `visible` + `onToggle` (or a usePasswordToggle helper returning { type, toggle, visible, button }). aria-pressed={visible}; i18n aria-label toggles showPassword/hidePassword. Document that it is meant to sit as a password Input's trailing affordance (Input's icon wrapper is pointer-events-none, so place the toggle with end-0 absolute + pointer-events-auto or outside that wrapper). Re-export from barrel.

Add co-located tests following button.test.tsx/tags.test.tsx: selectable-card.test.tsx (selected reflects aria-checked/data-state, toggles on Enter/Space), pagination.test.tsx (current page aria-current, onPageChange fires), button-group.test.tsx (pressed item aria-pressed, onValueChange fires), dropdown-labeled.test.tsx (Label associated with trigger via htmlFor/id), password-toggle.test.tsx (aria-pressed flips and aria-label changes).
acceptance_criteria: src/components/molecules/index.ts exists and exports SelectableCard, Pagination, ButtonGroup, DropdownLabeled, PasswordToggle (and their variants where applicable).
messages/en.json and messages/ar.json both contain the molecules namespace with the keys used by these components, with matching key sets.

Each component is TypeScript, uses cn, cva where variant-bearing, forwardRef where idiomatic, logical properties only (no left/right), semantic token utilities (works light+dark), and routes user-facing strings through next-intl.
No new dependency added to package.json; Eye/EyeOff come from lucide-react.
npx vitest run src/components/molecules passes for the 5 new test files.
verification: npx vitest run src/components/molecules (new tests for these 5 molecules pass)
findings: Barrel src/components/molecules/index.ts exists — ADD new re-exports here (don't recreate the file). Current exports: SelectableCard+selectableCardVariants, Pagination, ButtonGroup+buttonGroupVariants, DropdownLabeled, PasswordToggle+usePasswordToggle. i18n `molecules` namespace created in BOTH messages/en.json and messages/ar.json with keys: previous, next, page ('Page {page}'/'صفحة {page}'), showPassword, hidePassword — FEAT-002 must ADD searchPlaceholder, search, progress, expand, collapse to this same namespace in both files (keep key sets in sync). Testing pattern for components using next-intl: wrap render in <NextIntlClientProvider locale="en" messages={messages}> importing messages from '../../../messages/en.json' (resolveJsonModule is on); import * as React is needed in those test files for React.ReactElement typing. No test-utils helper exists — each test defines its own renderWithIntl inline. Client components ('use client') that call useTranslations('molecules'): Pagination, PasswordToggle. Server-safe (no 'use client', no hooks): DropdownLabeled. RTL arrows: use LeftArrowIcon/RightArrowIcon from @/components/icons with className 'rtl:rotate-180' for logical direction (Pagination pattern). Eye/EyeOff imported from 'lucide-react' directly (icon barrel does not export them). usePasswordToggle(initial=false) returns { visible, toggle, type, button } for wiring a password Input's trailing affordance. Verification all green on this commit: npx vitest run src/components/molecules (5 files / 15 tests pass), npm run typecheck (0 errors), npm run lint (0 errors; the single import/no-anonymous-default-export warning is pre-existing in lint-staged.config.mjs, unrelated).
